name: Resting in Pieces
summary: On Fenris Isle, Alaric's severed head calls for help from beyond the grave. He asks you to carry it across Fenris Keep to an unmarked grave near the stables, where his body lies.

sections.title: A Bodyguard Betrayed
sections.body: At Fenris Keep in Silverpine Forest, Alaric served Thule Ravenclaw as chief servant and personal bodyguard. Thule was a powerful mage aligned with the Scourge. When the Plague of Undeath swept through the region, he promised his sorcery would shield Alaric. Instead, the ward trapped him in endless agony and undeath, while his awareness remained in his severed parts.

sections.title: Plaything of the Rot Hides
sections.body: Thule made the rot hide gnolls by infecting local packs with necromantic decay. Then he turned on his own bodyguard. He cut off Alaric's head and threw it to the savage gnolls as a diversion. The rot hides dragged Alaric's body to a shallow grave they had hastily dug outside the keep's stables. They kept his speaking head as a grim plaything until an outsider intervened.

sections.title: Reuniting the Pieces
sections.body: Near the stables, a shallow grave holds Alaric's headless torso. Bring his severed head there, and his remains are reunited. Thule's curse still binds Alaric to undeath. Yet with his parts restored, he finds a bitter measure of relief.

faq.answer: Alaric served Thule Ravenclaw as chief servant and personal bodyguard at Fenris Keep. Thule's spell was meant to shield him from the Plague of Undeath, but instead bound him to eternal unlife.
Thule Ravenclaw beheaded Alaric after finishing his experiments to create the rot hide gnolls. He threw Alaric's severed, conscious head to them as a plaything.
Alaric's body lies in an unmarked, shallow grave dug in haste on Fenris Isle, in Fenris Keep's courtyard near the stable buildings.

faq.q: What are the rot hide gnolls?
faq.answer: The rot hide gnolls are local packs on Fenris Isle, transformed into rotting horrors touched by undeath through Thule Ravenclaw's necromantic experiments.
Thule Ravenclaw is a human wizard and Scourge necromancer who seized Fenris Keep in the middle of Lake Lordamere. He uses it as a laboratory to corrupt the gnolls and spread the Scourge's influence.

faq.q: What happens after you find the grave?
faq.answer: Once his remains are reunited, Alaric helps you find a hidden niche with a powerful wand. You can return it to Dalaran's Magus Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

angles.text: As a Forsaken champion, you will know the treacherous spellcraft of Thule Ravenclaw. Scourge-aligned sorcerers inflict such cruel horrors across Lordaeron.
As a mage, you can see how Thule twisted a defensive ward into an inescapable curse of severed undeath. His spell shows how necromancy can corrupt arcane magic.
